theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose a theme for the interface. Themes are available in Performance render mode.
theme.lockedDescription: When Quality or Medium render mode is active, the theme is locked to Forest (dark green) to match the map background. Switch to Performance mode to use custom themes.

verification.title: Account Verification
verification.accountVerified: Your account is verified and protected
verification.fullAccess: You have full access to all features.
verification.unavailableDescription: Account verification is temporarily disabled for maintenance. Please try again later or contact an admin via a
verification.description: Verify your DDNet nickname to unlock all features. Join one of the servers below, log in with /login, then click the button.
verification.verifyingDescription: Bot is checking your account on the server. This usually takes a few seconds.
verification.successDescription: Your nickname has been verified. Welcome!

errors.expired: Verification request expired. Please try again.
errors.notLoggedIn: You are not logged in on the server. Use /login to log in and try again.
errors.notFound: Player not found on the server. Make sure you are connected.
errors.offline: You are not online. Please join a verification server first.
errors.wrongServer: You are on the wrong server. Please join: {servers}

verification.unverifiedWarning: If you haven't verified your account, the real owner of this nickname can claim it by verifying their identity through our bot. Verify now to protect your account.

pushNotifications.title: Notifications
pushNotifications.label: Push Notifications
pushNotifications.description: Receive notifications about game invites and friend requests
pushNotifications.notSupported: Push notifications are not supported in this browser.

errors.notConfigured: Push not configured on server (no VAPID key)
errors.serviceUnavailable: Push service unavailable. Check: 1) Internet connection 2) Browser push is enabled in settings 3) No firewall/VPN blocking push services. Try: chrome://settings/content/notifications or about:preferences#privacy
